panels.title: Completed inference requests
panels.description: Terminal requests in the selected interval, including errors and cancellations. Excludes catalog, health checks and response-object operations. Prometheus increase estimates changes between scrapes.

panels.title: Inference success rate
panels.description: Successful terminal inference requests / all terminal inference outcomes. Success requires a normal 2xx/3xx response without an aborted stream or processing error. No observed denominator remains No data, never zero success.

panels.title: Inference throughput
panels.description: Terminal inference requests per second over Grafana's scrape-aware rate interval.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests currently tracked against logical models. This is not backend queue depth or hardware utilization.

panels.title: Inference outcomes
panels.description: One terminal outcome per processed inference request. Errors, cancellation, timeout and incomplete streams remain separate.

panels.title: Inference request duration (P50/P95/P99)
panels.description: Time from starting request processing to its terminal outcome, including routing and response streaming. All inference outcomes contribute. Histogram estimates use finite buckets through 1800 seconds; quantiles in the overflow bucket are capped at that boundary.

panels.title: Entrypoint requests by recipe
panels.description: Requests resolved to a configured entrypoint and recipe before selection or backend execution. This boundary is distinct from terminal outcomes above.

panels.title: Recipe model selections
panels.description: Successful model selections, not completed requests or quality measurements. Logical configuration names identify each recipe's selected decision and algorithm.

panels.title: Recipe stage duration
panels.description: Observed mean duration by recipe stage. Signals includes projection evaluation; algorithm measures selection, not model generation. Means use measured sums and counts without clipping long observations to histogram bucket bounds.

panels.title: Projection evaluations
panels.description: Recorded projection score observations per second. A projection score is not a quality probability; inspect the request's Projection Trace in Insights for its exact score and rule inputs.

panels.title: Signal matches by family
panels.description: Recorded rule matches, not a percentage of requests. One request can match several rules and signal families.

panels.title: Decision rule matches
panels.description: All matched decision rules with recipe-scoped names. Multiple rules can match one request; the winning route appears in Recipe model selections. Rule confidence is not model-answer quality.

panels.title: Reported tokens by model
panels.description: Tokens reported by response usage. Missing usage is not measured as zero; cache responses may include reused usage. Not billed cost, physical token generation or capability. Use Evaluation for frozen-price comparisons.

panels.title: Requests in flight by model
panels.description: Requests tracked against each logical model, collected at scrape time. No waiting-queue length or utilization is inferred.

panels.title: Response duration by model
panels.description: Mean duration from request-body processing through recorded response completion, including routing. This observation can include cache responses and is not the terminal-request population above.

panels.title: First response observation by model
panels.description: Mean time from request-body processing to the first observed streaming chunk or nonstreaming response headers. Includes routing and may precede a content token; not a uniform backend time-to-first-token measurement.

panels.title: Response duration per output token
panels.description: Mean of per-response duration / reported output-token count, for responses with output tokens. Includes routing and first-response wait; not decode inter-token latency or a token-weighted aggregate.

panels.title: Recorded model errors
panels.description: Instrumented model error events. Use Inference outcomes for request-level denominators; these diagnostic events are not a disjoint terminal-request counter.

panels.title: Plugin executions
panels.description: Instrumented plugin executions and recorded outcomes. Missing series do not imply success or that every configured plugin ran.

panels.title: Plugin duration
panels.description: Mean measured duration of instrumented plugin executions. Unknown or absent observations stay absent.

panels.title: Cache lookup outcomes
panels.description: Measured response-cache lookup hit, miss and error operations. Exact and semantic lookups stay distinct. One request can perform multiple lookups; these counts do not define a request-level hit percentage.

panels.title: Cache operation duration
panels.description: Mean wall-clock duration measured by the response-cache service. Uses timed canonical operations, not legacy backend callbacks that can report placeholder zero durations.

panels.title: Known model cost rate
panels.description: Known configured-price amounts only, not invoices or hardware cost. Unknown usage or prices are omitted; a known subtotal does not prove complete accounting. Currencies remain separate; no savings percentage is inferred. Each series is currency units per second attributed to a logical model. Do not add this series to Looper attempt cost: accounting scopes can overlap.

panels.title: Reported prompt and completion tokens
panels.description: Reported usage breakdown per second. Responses with only total-token usage do not enter this breakdown. Prompt tokens can include cache reads/writes; these series alone do not establish billed-token buckets.

panels.title: Looper attempt outcomes
panels.description: Detailed attempt instrumentation currently covers Confidence execution. An absent series for another algorithm does not prove zero attempts. One terminal event per instrumented attempt. Internal model/verifier attempts are distinct from public inference request outcomes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(llm_looper_attempt_duration_seconds_sum{job="semantic-router",instance=~"${router_instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) by (algorithm, stage, status) / (sum(rate(llm_looper_attempt_duration_seconds_count{job="semantic-router",instance=~"${router_instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) by (algorithm, stage, status) > 0)

panels.title: Looper attempt duration
panels.description: Detailed attempt instrumentation currently covers Confidence execution. An absent series for another algorithm does not prove zero attempts. Mean measured end-to-end attempt duration by stage and outcome. Milliseconds are converted to seconds by the emitter.

panels.title: Known Looper attempt cost rate
panels.description: Detailed attempt instrumentation currently covers Confidence execution. An absent series for another algorithm does not prove zero attempts. Known configured-price amounts only, not invoices or hardware cost. Unknown usage or prices are omitted; a known subtotal does not prove complete accounting. Currencies remain separate; no savings percentage is inferred. Each series is known currency units per second. Do not sum with model cost counters.

panels.title: Looper attempt tokens
panels.description: Detailed attempt instrumentation currently covers Confidence execution. An absent series for another algorithm does not prove zero attempts. Reported prompt/completion usage for internal model and verifier stages. These attempt observations may overlap model usage counters and must not be added to them.

panels.title: Telemetry scrape health
panels.description: All router and Jaeger scrape targets, independent of the Router instance filter. 1 means scrape success, 0 means failure; missing means no scrape evidence. Does not prove inference traces exist.

panels.title: Router trace export outcomes
panels.description: Spans in exporter batches. Excludes unsampled and SDK queue-dropped spans and does not prove durable collector storage. No data may mean no batch was exported in this interval.

title: vLLM Semantic Router
description: Measured inference outcomes, recipe routing, reported model usage, plugins and telemetry health. Missing observations remain No data.
